LESSON: READING FOR FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.6 Reading Aloud (2 lessons) • Word recognition • Intonation and tone B
Topic 2.8: Reading for Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading for Fluency, part of Reading 2.6 Reading Aloud (2 lessons) • Word recognition • Intonation and tone B in Grade 7 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can you enhance your understanding of texts when reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. describe seasons and weather patterns depicted in the pictures using keywords and phrases (e.g. 冷 lěng、 凉 liáng、暖 nuǎn、热 rè、炎热 yánrè、 雨季 yǔjì、旱季 hàn jì、冬 天 dōngtiān、春天 chūntiān、秋天 qiūtiān、夏天 xiàtiān),

2. work with peers to circle words and phrases related to different types of clothing items used in various seasons from a word search,

3. scan through a weather report on a newspaper or digital device and highlight words and phrases related to weather and seasons,

4. take turns reading simple texts on weather and seasons for fluency,

5. describe the scenes depicted in the pictures given for review by peers on their fluency,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. describe seasons and weather patterns depicted in the pictures using keywords and phrases (e.g. 冷 lěng、 凉 liáng、暖 nuǎn、热 rè、炎热 yánrè、 雨季 yǔjì、旱季 hàn jì、冬 天 dōngtiān、春天 chūntiān、秋天 qiūtiān、夏天 xiàtiān),
2. work with peers to circle words and phrases related to different types of clothing items used in various seasons from a word search,
3. scan through a weather report on a newspaper or digital device and highlight words and phrases related to weather and seasons,
4. take turns reading simple texts on weather and seasons for fluency,
5. describe the scenes depicted in the pictures given for review by peers on their fluency,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading for Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: the learner establishes strong networking skills as they undertake group activities and exchange

ideas on how to identify words from a word search.

• Learning to Learn: this is promoted as the learner builds on their own learning experiences through the peer review on

fluency.

Values:
Social Justice: the learner accords equal opportunities in sharing responsibilities when they create reading groups to develop

their reading fluency.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Cultural Awareness: the learner demonstrates an appreciation for the diversity of clothing choices across regions during the

various seasons of the year.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner links their learning to Social Studies on the concept of varied weather patterns and seasons in the environment.
